name: allowed-extension
title: Enum: Allowed Upload Extension
description: Allowed image file extensions for direct bucket upload pre-signing.
purpose: Limits which image file extensions can be prepared for direct upload.

values.webp: Modern web image format with strong compression support.
values.png: Lossless image format, often used for screenshots or graphics.
values.jpg: JPEG image format using the short common extension.
values.jpeg: JPEG image format using the long common extension.
values.heic: High efficiency image format, often produced by mobile devices.
values.heif: High efficiency image format variant, often produced by mobile devices.
